dct_description_sm: Investigating the dynamics of Arctic and sub-Arctic terrestrial communities at multiple spatio-temporal scales in order to better understand their sensitivity to anthropogenic perturbations. Such program is required to assess the extent of climate-induced effects on tundra ecosystems, which are experiencing a concomitant disappearance of their key herbivores (e.g. lemmings) and an increasing presence of boreal species (e.g. red foxes). Integrated research into drivers, processes and consequences of ecosystem changes.
dct_title_s: Integrated ecosystem research and monitoring in Nunavut, Canada
